issues.title: Ingest Pope County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $36,831,969 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($16,165,628), Road Fund ($8,261,429), Emergency Medical Service Fund ($5,502,701). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Circuit Court Automation-Dunham (Court Automation Fund)
issues.detail: The form prints category subtotals of $12,250.00 (supplies) and $18,000.00 (other services), which add to $30,250.00, but its printed total and the appropriation are $30,000.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
